about.title: Menifee Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Seven people died in traffic collisions in Menifee during 2025, according to public records, alongside 312 injury crashes that left 477 people hurt. Numbers like these are easy to read and impossible to feel until one of them is your husband, your mother, or your child. Menifee's daily traffic runs along Newport Road, Menifee Road, Murrieta Road and Scott Road, and reported crashes here cluster on Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. A wrongful death claim in Riverside County is a civil action, entirely separate from anything the district attorney may pursue. California allows a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children to bring the claim first, with certain dependents and heirs able to step in when no closer family exists. Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the income your loved one would have provided, and the harder-to-measure loss of their love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Menifee families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, free of charge to you.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on Newport Road. Does the criminal case decide our claim?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death case is a civil action that runs on its own track, separate from any charges the Riverside County District Attorney may file. Your claim can move forward whether or not a criminal case is opened, and its outcome does not depend on a conviction. An attorney can explain how evidence from the collision investigation may still be useful.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law gives first standing to the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children of the person who died. If there are none, certain dependents and heirs may be eligible instead. Because these rules are specific, an attorney will usually confirm eligibility before taking any other step.

items.question: What losses can a Menifee family actually recover?
items.answer: Recoverable losses typically include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have contributed over time, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Every family's situation is different, so no one can responsibly predict an amount in advance. An independent attorney reviews the facts and explains what may apply to your case.
